nodes.label: AssistanceService — 100% Statements (34/34)

N+1 prevention pattern, server-side pricing, loyalty processing in atomic $transaction. Uncovered: some edge branches in table session resolution and loyalty token lookup.

nodes.label: LoyaltyLedgerUtils — 90.19% Statements (46/51)
nodes.rationale: Loyalty ledger pure functions well-tested: 46/51 statements, 20/26 branches, 9/10 functions. Uncovered: markRemindersSent (entire function), zero redeem-rate branch, break in redemption loop, onlyUnnotified branch. Core FIFO logic (expire, redeem, earn) fully covered.

nodes.label: FeatureService — 61.53% Statements (8/13)
nodes.rationale: FeatureService partial coverage: 8/13 statements, 1/7 branches, 2/3 functions. getFeatures and hasFeature are covered; getStaffLimit is entirely uncovered. TIER_FEATURES maps FREE/STARTER/PROFESSIONAL/ENTERPRISE to 22 FeatureFlag constants.

nodes.label: PaymentService — 64.62% Statements (95/147)
nodes.rationale: PaymentService moderate coverage: 95/147 statements (64.62%), 56/93 branches (60.21%), 12/20 functions (60%). Stripe Connect integration, IPaymentProvider abstraction. Many uncovered branches in webhook handling and edge-case payment flows.

nodes.label: UsersService — 97.95% Statements (48/49)
nodes.rationale: UsersService has excellent coverage: 48/49 statements (97.95%), 23/25 branches (92%), 9/9 functions (100%). Two duplicate coverage reports exist (users/index.html and src/users/index.html) with identical stats.

nodes.label: Server-Side Price Calculation
nodes.rationale: Prevents price manipulation. OrdersService.create() ignores client-submitted prices — fetches current prices from DB, validates every option choice against the schema, and recalculates the total.

nodes.label: FIFO Loyalty Ledger
nodes.rationale: Points managed as discrete batches with expiry. Redemption draws oldest batches first. Expiry runs oldest-first. Never parallel Prisma writes inside $transaction — use updateMany instead. Deliberate accounting pattern.

nodes.label: Platform-Managed Translation Key
nodes.rationale: Restaurant owners never supply API keys. Platform holds single DEEPL_API_KEY. restaurant.deeplApiKey column deprecated and never read/written. Eliminates owner friction and prevents key leakage.

nodes.label: Lazy Translation with DB Caching
nodes.rationale: First request per language translates and persists to translations JSON field on each entity. Subsequent requests hit DB cache. Three paths: fire-and-forget pre-warm, owner-triggered Translate All, lazy on-demand.

nodes.label: SaaS Tiering V2 (FREE/STARTER/PRO/ENTERPRISE)
nodes.rationale: 4-tier pricing on Restaurant.tier. 22 feature flags enforced. Stripe Checkout + Portal + webhook. FeatureGuard + @RequireFeature decorator. 454 tests passing after Round 2 enforcement sweep.

nodes.label: Help Center CMS Design
nodes.rationale: Move all Help/FAQ content from hardcoded i18n JSON to DB-driven CMS. HelpContent model with section/categoryKey/itemKey/locale. Super-admin CRUD + public read endpoints. Landing FAQ + Dashboard help both consuming API.

nodes.label: BG Fiscal Device Integration (Tier 1 Gap)
nodes.rationale: Hard blocker for BG market. Bulgarian law requires every cash/card sale to hit a fiscal device (Datecs/Tremol/Eltrade + NRA reporting). Without it the product is illegal as a payment terminal in BG.

nodes.label: Delivery + Pickup Flow (Tier 1 Gap)
nodes.rationale: Currently dine-in only. Half the EU SMB-restaurant market wants takeaway/delivery. Needs Order.fulfillmentType enum (DINE_IN|TAKEAWAY|DELIVERY) + delivery address + scheduled-time + ETA.

nodes.label: Thermal KOT Printer (Tier 1 Gap)
nodes.rationale: PRINTERS_THERMAL flag exists but no driver implementation. Kitchens that aren't fully digital need printed tickets via ESC/POS over network + Bluetooth.

nodes.label: In-App Refunds (Tier 1 Gap)
nodes.rationale: Owners refuse to use Stripe dashboard for refunds. No refund button in PaymentsView. Needs POST /payments/:id/refund + UI with confirmation modal.

nodes.label: Staff Attribution & Itemized Bills
nodes.rationale: OrderSource enum (POS/QR) + staffUserId on Order. Source badges on dashboard order list, table detail cards, payment detail rows.

nodes.label: Table Zones/Sections
nodes.rationale: Zone field on RestaurantTable for large-restaurant POS filtering. POS table picker grouped by zone with section headers.

nodes.label: Onboarding Wizard Overhaul
nodes.rationale: New-user wizard rewritten with tier-aware Stripe Checkout (FREE→Starter skips payment), Stripe Connect onboarding integrated, owner name collected, table setup flow.
